name: GeoStep
learning_rate_schedule: linear recovery 10000-11000, then cosine decay through 30000
loss_units: masked velocity MSE or regression MSE in [-1,1] coordinates; objectives not cross-comparable
task_split: dev128 only; existing eval256 and final test are not evaluated in this continuation
resume_rng: restore explicit data/noise generator states from each original 10000 checkpoint

decision_thresholds.interpretation: diagnostic thresholds, not universal convergence guarantees; image-level intervals exclude training-seed uncertainty; do not infer equivalence from non-significance

limitations: original mask position and foreground confounding remains
LR recovery and added updates are a joint optimization intervention
